# AI Action Studio

> AI Action Studio is an AI automation agency. We build and maintain AI agents, workflow automations, custom software and integrations that take manual work off growing businesses worldwide. We work remotely. Founder: Ranjan Kashyap.

Every project starts with a free 30-minute systems audit, then a fixed-price blueprint, a build delivered in weekly stages, and a monthly care plan that keeps the system running. We start with the client's process, not a tool, and use AI only where it is reliable.

## Services
- [AI agents for business](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/ai-agents): AI receptionists and voice agents, website and WhatsApp chat agents, lead qualification and booking, connected to the client's CRM.
- [Business process automation](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/workflow-automation): replacing spreadsheets, manual data entry and email approvals with automated workflows.
- [Custom software development](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/custom-software): custom CRMs, order, inventory and HR apps and internal tools.
- [Accounts payable and HR automation](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/finance-hr-automation): invoice capture, payables approvals, receivables reminders, payroll inputs and onboarding, connected to QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books or Tally.
- [API integration services](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/integrations): connecting CRM, ERP, accounting and HR tools; Zapier, Make and n8n builds; custom API integrations.
- [WhatsApp automation](https://aiactionstudio.com/services/whatsapp-automation): WhatsApp Business API replies, follow-ups, and CRM and accounting integration.
- [All services](https://aiactionstudio.com/services)
